t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Yellow baskets have more mushrooms - Change baskets when shrooms are low

vb_textbox.text: The colour of the gnomes hats correspond to the colour of basket. Yellow baskets are determined by colours closer to yellow e.g. green, blue. Red baskets are determined by colours closer to red e.g. red, brown, purple. My advice would be to alternate between colours when the mushrooms drop lower - however Yellow seemed to yield a higher amount of mushrooms. Multipliers help massively. The colour of the gnomes corespond to the baskets throughout. Use your breaks to mentally recharge. You only need to tap the space bar once to collect the mushrooms, I was mashing the spacebar in the first round. Good luck!
